purpose: Introduce a decisive reason that explains a reaction.
keywords: give explain a reason cause result
express feelings speak politely show respect
After all, it is my first time, so I am nervous.
There are so many people that preparing is hard.
Let’s leave early; the road is very narrow, after all.
restrictions: Often followed by から or ので.
mistake: It foregrounds a reason rather than simply changing topic.
